label: Necessary concrete external cause, Euclidean at the selected world
meaning: Frame-scope weakening of LocalFramePossibleExternalCause.necessaryConcrete: the global Euclidean premise is replaced by Euclidean access at the selected world w only; the Scenario, possible-beginning and causal-opportunity predicates are unchanged. Opportunity applied to the possible beginning gives an accessible v with an existing concrete external totality-cause c; the existing necessaryOfExternalCandidate gives that c is necessary at v. Euclidean access and reflexivity at w carry the SAME c to w and to every successor of w. No causal role is transported to w. No premise is discharged.
